event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Tech rout, Dow green, small caps won.
Core PCE YoY printed 3.3% vs 3.20% fc and GDP revised to 4.3% vs 3.5% — a hot-inflation, hot-growth mix that kept XLK at -0.83% while money hunted value and materials; SPY and QQQ both sit below their 200-day MAs, and the tape is absorbing that with participation intact (74% advancers) rather than capitulating.

INDICES — VIX 26.4, above its 22.6 20-day MA.
IJH +1.19%, RSP +0.83%, IJR +0.73%, IWM +0.65%, DIA +0.31%, SPY -0.29%, SOXX -0.50%, QQQ -0.65%. Small > large by 1.02pp. Biggest cross-asset move: USO +3.29% alongside TLT +0.92% — oil up with bonds bid. SPY and QQQ are BELOW their 200-day MAs — live CTA sell trigger.

VOLUME & BREADTH — Money moved out of megacap into mid/small.
IJH at 1.4x with price up = accumulation; RSP 1.2x with price up = accumulation; DIA 1.1x similarly. SPY and QQQ vol_ratio are not in the feed; by sector, XLI 1.4x and XLK 1.2x gained, XLE 0.7x and XLC 0.7x lost. Breadth: 59% above 50DMA, 54% above 200DMA, 370/129 advancers, up/down volume 1.15, 49 new 60d highs vs 5 lows, narrow_rally False — participation confirms a broadening tape, not a mega-cap one.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLB Materials +2.07%, XLRE Real Estate +0.92%, XLC Comms +0.89%, XLI Industrials +0.83%, XLE Energy +0.74%, XLF Financials +0.71%, XLU Utilities +0.48%, XLP Staples +0.46%, XLY Discretionary -0.20%, XLV Healthcare -0.56%, XLK Technology -0.83%.
Top industries MSOS +4.82% and SILJ +4.35%; bottom DRAM -3.03% and MAGS -1.05%.
Flows: XLK +414mm (83p) and XLC +291mm (92p) lead inflows while XLE -1823mm (0p) and XLV -1199mm (2p) bleed — tech inflows against a tech price drop = dip-buying/short-covering, contradicting the price ranking.
Rotation call: strongest are materials and precious metals; weakest are semis/memory and healthcare. Label: 'AI hardware fading / high-to-low rotation'.

POSITIONING — Protection bid, dispersion wide.
SPY PCR_vol 1.54 and IWM 2.73 are elevated; skew +11.8% on SPY/QQQ; VIX 26.4 vs 22.6 MA. VIXEQ 51.6 vs VIX 26.4 — a wide gap signals high single-stock dispersion and low implied correlation, a rotation/stock-picker tape.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil up, gold up, dollar flat.
USO +3.29% versus JETS -0.88% shows energy cost pressure hitting airlines; GLD +0.61% with SLV +0.71% and UUP -0.10% is rotation into hard assets. Next FOMC Dec 9, 2026: Polymarket prices 94% for a 25bp hike (+4pp in 5 days) and 4% no change — hike odds firming sharply.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 56, Neutral.
Movers: LRCX -5.68% (wafer-equipment headline), ORCL -5.13% (hyperscaler balance-sheet doubts), WPM +5.15%. Momentum leaders XLRE/XLP, laggard XLK. Vol spike UTES 3.2x with price flat = churn. Watch tomorrow: SOXX (98p inflows against -0.50%, 5d -9.78%), IJH (1.4x volume, +1.19%), and SLV (2.2x volume, -24.38% over 20d — a volume-heavy mean-reversion candidate).
